actions.description: Pinned VICE cc67418cba58e71d8e70fd353e9de47199ad2075 source verified by Git blob identity for six files. datasette.c:1052-1099 and1110-1151 distinguish STOP/START/FF/REWIND, accepted writable-image RECORD, read-only rejection and no-image RECORD no-op. c64datasette.c:36-55 separates CIA1 FLAG pulse events from memory tape sense; c64pla.c:65-66 clears CPU port input bit4; c64mem.c:255-271 maps CPU port to0001. VIC20 uses VIA1 tape sense/vic20via1.c:246-251 bit6 with DDR masking. datasette.c:1182-1200 delays motor stop and cancels a pending stop on motor-on; DatasetteMotorRampTests.MotorOff_ThenOn_ResetsRamp instead requires restart after one off Tick. Existing managed C64MemoryMap.cs:1325-1333 already uses CPU port bit4 correctly; the stale FR/TR/test comments, not that method, claim CIA1. DatasetteSenseLineTests.TryWritePulse_StorePulse_WhenRecordPressed constructs no tape yet expects a successful recorded pulse, whereas native write path requires an image, RECORD mode and motor. These are source-inspection findings; no native or managed execution occurred.

The four legacy FRs already had zero structured AC in the preserved pre-rename snapshots; current title/body/status match those snapshots exactly. The staged recovery proposals explicitly mark all four sets of criteria inferred, so copying them would not recover verified historical AC. FR-RUNTIME-TAPE-002 also contains a Boolean contradiction and incorrect C64 sense-port attribution. Prepare a source-backed correction proposal for this FR and its two mapped TR/two TEST records; leave authoritative requirements and production code unchanged pending exact-delta approval and applicable HV gates.

Created an unapplied five-record exact field delta: FR-RUNTIME-TAPE-002, TR-TAP-EDGE-001, TR-TAPE-EDGE-001, TEST-TAPE-RAMP-001, TEST-TAPE-SENSE-001. 23 unsatisfied AC, proposed statuses pending, two TEST title corrections. No record retired, IDs/mappings unchanged. Initial draft copied/hash-verified and retained. Full current JSON body persisted in three ordered dialog chunks. Operator approval requested asynchronously; no answer assumed. No new HV acceptance.

Documentation skill used to separate source-backed findings, exact field changes, evidence limitations and post-approval gates. Before/after effective requirement comparison shows no drift in the 516 existing records; six native source pins and five managed input pins unchanged, all eight native baseline fields match, git diff --check exit0. No product build/test run. Corrected excerpt-generation Math.Min type mismatch before any excerpt file was written; final 24 excerpt ranges retained. One exploratory rg command named a nonexistent Machines directory; corrected with file discovery and a full Core search.
